meta.description: PipeMD Agent A/B Benchmark v2 baselines. Multi-ecosystem, 3-condition.
meta.note: v2 redesign: STATIC replaces bare WITHOUT (realistic control = hand-written AGENTS.md). Self-referential pipemd-doctor task dropped; portfolio now spans TS/Lua/Python/Go. Old v1 results are NOT comparable (different control arm + different tasks).

05-json-dates.task: real bug hono #1800: c.json() rejects Date; fix-light, exploration-heavy

methodology.metrics: input_tokens (last-turn peak incl. cache), output_tokens, tool_calls, reads, edits, writes, greps, globs, wall_ms, quality
methodology.comparison_rule: Only compare efficiency metrics at equal quality levels
methodology.with_pmd: Full active mode: daemon running, opencode plugin installed, AGENTS.md rendered with live <!-- pmd: --> blocks
methodology.passive: AGENTS.md rendered once (legacy file mode), daemon then killed — frozen snapshot, no plugin
methodology.static: Hand-written-style AGENTS.md generated by glm-5.1 (cached, committed), NO pmd blocks, no daemon, no plugin — the realistic control
methodology.headline_verdict: WITH vs STATIC: does dynamic injection beat a normal static AGENTS.md?
methodology.task_shape: middle-length: read 3-6 files to learn patterns, touch 2-4 files, pass a NATIVE gate (tsc/vitest, lua, pytest, go test)
